{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|spinward}}
In [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] cartography and [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], '''spinward''' was the opposite of [[trailing]]. Spinward referred to bodies rotating north and/or east relative to an object's position orbiting the [[Galactic Center|center]] as [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] spun counterclockwise.
